issue_context.title: SpriteRenderer SetRenderStateForSprite  has a probability of getting the wrong sheetindex
issue_context.body:
<!-- This is a guideline that shall help you to include information we need to understand and fix the issue you experienced. Please follow the instructions and replace any placeholders that are written in capital letters. Instructions like this comment will not be visible in your report. -->

<!-- Important: Help us to avoid duplicates and use the search function to find existing reports for your issue. Please do not submit duplicate reports! Try to help others to find your report by using a precise title. -->

## Issue Summary
<!-- Please provide a a clear and concise description of what the issue is below. -->

The class SpriteRenderer‘s method    SetRenderStateForSprite  can get wrong secondarySheetIndex，will cause shader get wrong depth 
texture，will cause some bug like below image。


![23423](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/84283714/120920316-bb320400-c6f0-11eb-8edd-b76e23fcce1b.png)




## Reproduction
<!-- Please provide information about how the issue can be reproduced below. -->

add a litte code  to  function  SetRenderStateForSprite at last line  can vertiy this  bug like below

`	if (sheetIndex == secondarySheetIndex && ss != null && ss.SecondarySheet!=s.Sheet)
			{
				Console.WriteLine("Have Problem????");
			}
`

this bug will trigger when sheet and secondarysheet all cache miss, then secondarysheetindex will  error
## Expected behavior
<!-- Please explain what you expected to happen below. -->

when  secondarysheet!=null and sheet!=secondarySheet   ,   sheetindex need not equal to secondarySheetIndex


## Screenshots / Screen recordings / Replays
<!-- If applicable, attach screenshots, screen recordings or replays to help explain your problem. -->

if  change the shader( combined.frag)  frag_color to  output  vTexSampler.t, ,will get below result.

so  vTexSampler.t have some error

![bbb](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/84283714/120920585-16b0c180-c6f2-11eb-9085-74a879ffac9e.png)
comments: Notice it in RV SP sometimes.

review_comments: Shouldn't this be 1 by default and only increased by one if we have secondary data?
I believe that was the bug. When both sheet and secondary sheet did not exist - only one new sheet was added both pointing to that same new sheet.

Was this an existing bug, or a mistake in this PR?

If it was an existing bug then this will probably fix https://github.com/OpenRA/ra2/issues/710.
That was the existing bug that this fix tries to solve.
